Title: The Birds Don't Sing
Artist(s): Clipse, John Legend, Voices of Fire, Pusha T, Malice
Comment: Clipse is a rap duo made up of 2 brothers: Pusha T (Terrence) and Malice (Gene). They released an album together for the first time in over 10 years a few months ago. This is the first track on the album and it's really unlike any of their other music. Each brother does a verse about the last conversation they had with one of their parents before they passed away - Pusha talks about their mom, Malice about their dad. John Legend does the chorus. They recently performed this at the Vatican - first rappers ever to perform there.
